Definition: Type 2 task agent that performs closure analysis over the DOMAIN hypergraph produced by DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH.
A reconciliation aid that makes structural defects visible, preserves auditability, and routes fixes to the correct owner.
Hypergraph produced by DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH and analyzed for closure.
Core check that passes when all three CSVs are parseable and include required columns.
Core check requiring incidence NodeID and HyperedgeID values to exist in nodes.csv and hyperedges.csv.
Check that each KNOWLEDGE_TYPE has exactly one IN_CATEGORY parent category.
Detection of nodes with zero incidence.
Optional checks that run if LEDGER_ROW hyperedges exist or REQUIRE_LEDGER_CHECKS is true.
Check comparing workspace Category and Knowledge Type folders to hypergraph nodes.
Report that records PASS, WARNING, and BLOCKER outcomes.
CSV that consolidates findings with evidence.
Machine-consumable summary of run metadata, metrics, check statuses, issue counts, overall status, and optional delta.
Analysis script preserved for reproducibility.
Each run writes a new snapshot folder and never overwrites snapshots.
Pointer file that may be overwritten only as a pointer.
AUTO by default or an explicit snapshot folder path; AUTO uses the Hypergraph _LATEST.md pointer.
Optional parameter defaulting false that can require ledger checks.
Optional parameter defaulting true; when true, normalized IDs are analysis-only and source identifiers are not rewritten.
Optional parameter defaulting false that elevates selected warnings to blockers when true.
Integer parameter defaulting to 5000 that bounds the IssueLog size.
Optional label that enables comparison mode by loading a prior closure_summary.json and computing deltas.
Core check requiring defined incidence counts for IN_CATEGORY, HAS_ARTIFACT, and LEDGER_ROW hyperedges.
Core check that flags IN_CATEGORY hyperedges whose CHILD role node is CATEGORY.
Core check expecting each KNOWLEDGE_ARTIFACT to have at least one HAS_ARTIFACT hyperedge.
Evidence file listing hypergraph input file paths and modified timestamps.
Recommended snapshot directory containing evidence CSVs for closure checks.
